title: Inverted-F Antenna on a PCB
caption: 5.8 GHz step-by-step simulation. Build the geometry, mesh it, run openEMS and read the S-parameters, the 3D antenna pattern and the E-field.

title: The main window
caption: Menu bar, Project/Geometry tree, workspace tabs and the status/log area. Most commands live in the Geometry, Mesh and Simulation menus; the tabs open the mesh and result viewers.
side_card: 1  Menu bar: File, Geometry, Mesh, Simulation
2  Project / Geometry tree: objects, materials, ports
3  Tabs: Geometry, Mesh Viewer, 3D Design, S-Params, Antenna, Field
4  Status bar: progress, runtime and log toggle

title: Start a new project
caption: File -> New Project (Ctrl+N). The project stores the drawing unit, geometry, mesh, ports and results in one .fcsim.json file; save it with Ctrl+S.
side_card: Settings -> Settings… for the work folder

title: Set the frequency range
caption: Simulation -> Simulation Parameters… (Ctrl+Shift+P): drawing unit mm, start 5.0 GHz, stop 6.6 GHz, target 5.8 GHz. The target drives the mesh and the NF2FF evaluation.

title: Create the FR4 material
caption: Geometry -> Add Material…: kind dielectric, eps_r = 4.4, tan_d = 0.02. The material is used by the substrate box; copper is a separate PEC material.

title: Add the PCB substrate
caption: Geometry -> Add Box…: name PCB_FR4, material FR4, priority 1. Start 0/0/0 mm, stop 25/45/1.6 mm. Start is the lower corner, Stop the upper corner; x is board width, y board length, z through the substrate.
side_card: x right, y along the board, z up
All values in the drawing unit (mm)

title: Bottom ground plane (GND_bottom)
caption: Second box: Start 0/0/0, Stop 25/45/0.035 mm, material copper, priority 10. It covers the whole board and is the return/reference plane; the zmin boundary is PEC as well.

title: Top ground plane (GND_top)
caption: Third box: Start 0/0/1.6, Stop 25/35/1.635 mm, copper, priority 10. It stops at y = 35 mm; y = 35...45 mm is the 10 mm antenna clearance (no box). It is the local feed reference; a production board would stitch it to the bottom ground with vias.

title: Radiating arm (IFA_arm)
caption: Fourth box: Start 10/38/1.6, Stop 17/40/1.635 mm, copper, priority 10. 7 mm long, 2 mm wide; the open end is at x = 17 mm. This is the main radiator.

title: Shorting stub (IFA_short)
caption: Fifth box: Start 10/35/1.6, Stop 12/40/1.635 mm, copper, priority 10. 2 mm wide and 5 mm high; it connects the arm at y = 40 to the top ground at y = 35 and sets the quarter-wave resonance.

title: Feed strip and feed gap (IFA_feed)
caption: Sixth box: Start 12.5/35.5/1.6, Stop 14.5/38/1.635 mm, copper, priority 10. 2 mm wide; it connects the arm at y = 38 to the feed point at y = 35.5. The y = 35.0...35.5 mm gap to GND_top is the 0.5 mm port gap (no box).

title: Add the 50 ohm feed port
caption: Geometry -> Add Port…: lumped, 50 ohm, direction y, width area along x. Start 13.5/35.5/1.6, Stop 13.5/35.0/1.6 mm; metal reference IFA_feed. It spans the 0.5 mm gap and is 2 mm wide.
side_card: Width: Area - as wide as the metal (x)

title: Add the E-field dump
caption: Geometry -> Add Field Dump…: quantity E, frequency 5.8 GHz, file type VTK, box around the antenna. The Field Viewer reads this .vtr file later.

title: Enable the NF2FF far field
caption: Simulation -> Simulation Parameters… -> NF2FF-Parameter: enable far-field, frequency list 5.8 GHz, box automatic, theta = 181, phi = 361. This produces the antenna-pattern data.

title: Set the mesh parameters
caption: Mesh -> Mesh Parameters… (Ctrl+Shift+M): max 1.2 mm, min 0.15 mm, min z 0.08 mm, refined 0.2 mm, 18 cells per wavelength. Apply writes them into the project.

title: Build the mesh
caption: Mesh -> Build Mesh (Ctrl+M). easyMesh resolves the feed gap and the copper edges; the Mesh Viewer opens the XY slice at z = 1.6 mm.

title: Check the mesh quality
caption: In the Mesh Viewer use the Cell sizes tab (or the right-click menu) to see the cell-size distribution. The gap and the metal edges need the finest cells; air can stay coarse.

title: Run the FDTD simulation
caption: Simulation -> Run Simulation (Ctrl+R). Watch the TS and energy bars; the run stops at the energy criterion. The log lists the S-parameter and NF2FF files.

title: Read the S-parameters
caption: Open the S-Params tab. Plot |S| dB, click the plot to add a marker at 5.8 GHz, and use the trace preset for return loss. Smith, VSWR, phase and Re/Im are in the same Plot menu.

title: Read the antenna pattern
caption: Open the Antenna tab. The 3D Pattern view colours gain in dBi; the Plot selector adds E-/H-plane and azimuth cuts. Markers read gain, angle and HPBW.

title: Inspect the E-field
caption: Open the Field Viewer tab. In the Data panel choose pt:magnitude, the XY slice at z = 1.6 mm, or a YZ cut through the feed. The hot spot sits at the 0.5 mm gap and along the arm.

title: Done - and what to tune next
caption: Change one dimension at a time, rebuild the mesh and compare S11 and the pattern. The same workflow scales to other PCB antennas and feed structures.
